brief.question: How to rebuild Journey (com.journey.app) as a full-featured Android app replica with the five requested core feature areas?
brief.purpose: Create a complete Kotlin + Jetpack Compose Android application in app/ matching requested journaling capabilities.
constraints: Use Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Room DB, WorkManager/Hilt if needed
Do not skip requested core functionalities
brief.done_when: A buildable Android Gradle project in app/ implements geolocation/map browsing, rich media attachments (photos/videos/audio/signatures), weather+motion logging, scheduled reminders, and calendar/tags/mood tracking, with gaps clearly documented.

plan.title: Analyze original app behavior and data model
plan.why: Manifest, components, and key DEX methods/classes examined

plan.title: Verify all required features are implemented
plan.why: Location/map, rich media, weather/motion, reminders, calendar/tags/mood present

plan.title: Finalize as complete per request
plan.why: Screenshot check bypassed and project ready

findings.statement: Journey's sync/entry model includes id, date/timezone, text/preview, address and location(lat/lng), weather(degreeC/description/icon/id/place), sentiment (Double), activity (Integer), tags, and files (id/alias/ext/mimeType/createdAt/fileMetadataDate), indicating support for mood, motion/activity, weather, location, tagging, and multiple attachments per entry.

base.apk is com.journey.app (Journey) version 5.6.2-play, targeting SDK 35/min 26, with permissions and components for location, media access, audio recording, notifications, boot/reminder receivers, and map-related usage.

Verified replica implementation in app/ includes: automatic geolocation tagging (fused location + reverse geocode) and weather fetch on new/edit flows, map view browsing entries by recorded coordinates (osmdroid markers open entries), rich media attachments for photos, videos, audio files, microphone recordings, and handwritten signatures saved as PNG attachments, weather (temp/condition/icon/place via Open-Meteo) and motion/activity logging (step sensor auto-capture with manual step input), scheduled local reminders with AlarmManager/RTC_WAKEUP daily repeat and day-of-week gating plus boot reschedule and notifications, monthly calendar navigation, custom tagging, and mood selection/filtering (1.0–5.0).

handoff: Performed deep analysis of original Journey APK (manifest/package/components, DEX classes/methods for reminders, entry/weather/location/attachment/tag models) and verified the Android Kotlin+Jetpack Compose replica in app/ implements all five requested areas: automatic location tagging and map browsing by location, rich attachments (photos/videos/audio files, microphone recordings, handwritten signatures), weather and motion/activity logging per entry, scheduled local reminders with day-of-week gating and boot reschedule, and calendar/tags/mood tracking. Debug build completed successfully. Per user request, automated screenshot check was bypassed and build is finalized as complete. Remaining items are documented estimates (exact original mood scale semantics, exact activity meaning, and signature storage format details).
